rationale.r1_result: Crossed factorization and acquisition transfer improved, but biology retention and raw cycle MSE lagged the matched control.
rationale.remaining_problem: Preserve source biological identity during acquisition intervention without sacrificing the R2 gains in acquisition transfer and normalized cycle fidelity.

isolation.confirmation_rule: Any R3-selected configuration must be frozen and pass fresh development-holdout seeds before a new prospective real-data confirmation experiment.

architectures.difference: Candidate enables crossed reconstruction and biological/acquisition cycle preservation; primary control sets those three weights to zero. Both receive the same biological contrastive loss and all R2 regularizers.

biological_contrastive.positive_definition: same paired biological identity/region across different observed scanners
biological_contrastive.negative_definition: different biological identities/regions in the same training batch
biological_contrastive.selection_rule: Select the lowest weight that satisfies every unchanged R2 promotion gate. If no weight passes, R3 fails and no configuration is selected.

promotion_gate_per_weight.note: The gate is intentionally unchanged from R2 apart from evaluating the frozen contrastive-weight cells separately.

prohibited_after_freeze: change contrastive weight grid after observing R3 outputs
change R3 seeds after observing R3 outputs
relax any R2 promotion gate after observing R3 outputs
use frozen September 29 SCORPION confirmation outcomes to select the R3 configuration
